headline: President Obama authorized calling certain military reserve members to active duty.
what_it_does: This order allows the military to call up members of the Selected Reserve and some members of the Individual Ready Reserve for active duty. Reservists usually train part-time and keep civilian jobs until they are called up. The title does not say how many people may be called, for how long, or for what mission.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Selected Reserve in the armed forces
who_it_affects.how: They may be ordered to leave civilian life and serve on active military duty.
Some former service members still on reserve status may be ordered back to active duty.
They may lose a worker or family member to active military service for a period of time.
